data.animaCaption: Sitting atop stacked landing mats with her track jacket zipper snagged just below her collarbone, she pulls awkwardly at the tab and looks up with a crimson blush. A slanted beam of late-afternoon sun cuts across the dusty storage room and warms her damp neck.
data.promptProse: Viewed from slightly above inside a quiet school gym equipment room, Ayachi Nene perches on a stack of canvas landing mats after club cleanup. Her navy-and-white cropped track jacket is stuck half-unzipped over a snug white athletic tank top and short gym shorts, exposing her flushed collarbone and a hint of cleavage as her fingers fumble helplessly with the snagged metal zipper pull. A dramatic diagonal column of golden sunset light pours down from a high transom window, illuminating drifting chalk dust and soft beads of perspiration along her neck and shoulders.
data.story: 搬完社团器材的器材室闷热又安静。宁宁坐在跳高海绵垫上想拉好运动外套，拉链却偏偏卡在锁骨下进退不得，被夕阳照得通红的脸藏都藏不住——「等、等一下！不要靠这么近看……拉链咬住内搭布料了啦！」
